rules: Use original class labels; source classes 0..5 and target classes 6..9 never overlap.
This is the mask special case of a codebook: C[0]=0; every selected feature-hidden edge has a separate learned nonzero value.
A mask chooses 64 of 196 image pixels; it is repeated across 16 hidden neurons. There are binomial(196,64) candidates, not an enumerable small catalogue.
Within each task, separate source train/validation/test lineages evolve independently. Parent selection never crosses these roles.
Retain the best quarter of source solutions by query BCE for the prior; near-perfect accuracy is not required.
Source-only tuning must finish before inspecting target tasks or official test metrics.
Do not claim that a predefined DeepSets architecture is structure discovered by this experiment.
